ttl.name: Rear Seat Outer Belt Assembly Center

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Headrest Assembly Center
Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.
Remove the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly RH.
Fold the rear seat assembly RH forward.
Remove the 2 rear side bolts and remove the rear seat assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Seat Outer Belt Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and disconnect the rear seat outer belt assembly center together with the rear seat inner belt assembly.
Remove the washer and rear seat outer belt assembly center from the rear seat inner belt assembly.
Using a Torx socket wrench T45, remove the 2 Torx bolts and 2 bushings, and remove the rear seatback assembly RH.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the claws and remove the center armrest hinge cover by sliding it as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Armrest Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and bushing.
Pull the rear seat armrest assembly CTR off the pin and remove it.
Remove the bushing from the rear seatback assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Lock Control Lever w/ Base

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 screws.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the rear seatback lock control lever w/ base.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Shoulder Belt Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat shoulder belt hole cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seatback Lock Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws and remove the rear seatback lock cover RH.
Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seatback cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seatback Board Carpet Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, remove the 2 clips.
Using a clip remover, remove the 2 clips.
Disengage each J hook and remove the rear seatback board carpet assembly RH.
Disengage the 4 claws and remove the 2 rear seat headrest supports.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Separate Type Rear Seatback Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the separate type rear seatback cover w/ pad from the rear seatback frame sub-assembly RH.
Remove the 8 hog rings.
Remove the 10 hog rings and remove the separate type rear seatback cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Outer Belt Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and remove the rear seat outer belt assembly center.
